exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Ordering a Healthy Lunch
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Janet
transcript.text: I think I'll have a double hamburger with chips and a large cola.

transcript.speaker: Harriet
transcript.text: Not a good idea, Janet. Did you know that one cola has as much sugar as about eight spoonfuls?

transcript.speaker: Janet
transcript.text: Really? That much sugar in one drink?

transcript.speaker: Harriet
transcript.text: Yes. And that sugar attacks your teeth for around twenty minutes each time you drink it.

transcript.speaker: Janet
transcript.text: Hmm. So what should I order instead?

transcript.speaker: Harriet
transcript.text: Why not try a fresh fruit juice? It's sweet but much healthier.

transcript.speaker: Janet
transcript.text: All right. And maybe a salad too?

transcript.speaker: Harriet
transcript.text: Good choice. But ask for the dressing on the side — some dressings are full of fat.

transcript.speaker: Janet
transcript.text: Thanks, Harriet. You've saved me from a very unhealthy lunch!

exercises.translation_cn: Janet 本想点双层汉堡配薯条和大杯可乐;Harriet 提醒一杯可乐含糖约八勺,且每次都会侵蚀牙齿约二十分钟;建议改喝鲜榨果汁,再点一份沙拉,但酱汁分开放,因为有些酱汁脂肪很高。

questions.stem: What does Janet first want to order?
options: A burger with chips and a large cola.

questions.stem: How much sugar does Harriet say a cola has?
How long does the sugar attack the teeth each time?
What drink does Harriet suggest instead?
Why should Janet ask for the dressing on the side?
options: Some dressings contain a lot of fat.

exercises.title: U1 听力·独白 A Tip on Table Manners
exercises.speaker: uk_male
exercises.transcript: Good evening, and welcome to our short guide on table manners. Here is one simple rule that works almost everywhere: wait until everyone at the table has been served before you start to eat. It shows respect for the people around you. If there are many knives and forks, don't worry. Just start with the ones on the outside and work your way in. And when you have finished, place your knife and fork together on your plate. Remember, you needn't be perfect — just watch your host and follow what they do.
exercises.translation_cn: 餐桌礼仪小贴士:几乎处处适用的一条简单规则是,等桌上每个人都上了菜再动筷,这是对周围人的尊重;若刀叉很多,从最外侧开始向内用;吃完后把刀叉并排放在盘子上;不必做到完美,只要留心并模仿主人的做法即可。

questions.stem: What should you do before you start eating?
options: Start as soon as you sit down.
Ask the waiter for more food.
Wait until everyone has been served.

questions.stem: Which knife and fork should you pick up first?
What should you do when you finish?
options: Place the knife and fork together on the plate.

questions.stem: What does waiting for others show?
options: Respect for the people around you.
That you are in a hurry.

questions.stem: What is the speaker's final advice?
options: Bring your own knife and fork.
Watch your host and do as they do.

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Choosing Dishes at a Restaurant
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: This menu looks great, but I really can't decide what to have.

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: If you like spicy food, you should try the Gong Bao chicken. It's the chef's best dish.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Spicy chicken with peanuts? That sounds good. What about you?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: I'm a vegetarian, so I'll have the tofu and vegetables.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Good idea. Shall we share a soup as well?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: Yes, but let's avoid the very salty one. How about the tomato and egg soup?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Perfect. And for dessert?

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: They make a wonderful fruit pudding here. It's sweet but not too heavy.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: You really know this place well!

transcript.speaker: Lucy
transcript.text: I should — I come here almost every week!

exercises.translation_cn: Tom 拿不定主意点什么;Lucy 推荐厨师拿手的宫保鸡丁;她自己吃素,点豆腐配蔬菜;两人合点一份汤,避开很咸的那种,选番茄蛋汤;甜点选清甜不腻的水果布丁;Lucy 说自己几乎每周都来这家店。

questions.stem: What does Lucy recommend to Tom?

exercises.title: U1 听力·独白 How to Make Quick Fried Rice
exercises.speaker: uk_female
exercises.transcript: Today I'll show you how to make a quick and tasty fried rice. First, heat a little oil in a pan. When the oil is hot, add an egg and stir it quickly. Next, add your cold rice and mix it well so that each grain is covered. Then add some chopped vegetables and a spoonful of soy sauce for flavour. Cook everything for two or three minutes over a high heat. Finally, add a little salt if you need to, and serve it hot. It's so easy that you needn't be a chef to get it right!
exercises.translation_cn: 教你做快手炒饭:先在锅里热点油;油热后打入鸡蛋快速翻炒;再加入冷米饭拌匀,让每粒米都裹上;然后加些切碎的蔬菜和一勺酱油提味;大火炒两三分钟;最后按需加点盐,趁热上桌。非常简单,不必当厨师也能做好。

options: It is easy enough for anyone to make.

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Planning a Family Dinner
exercises.speaker: uk_male

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: My parents are coming for dinner on Saturday. What should we cook?

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Well, your dad loves roast beef, doesn't he?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: He does, but Mum says we shouldn't eat too much roast food.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: True. How about a roast chicken with lots of fresh vegetables instead?

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: That's lighter. Good idea. And for a starter?

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: We could make a simple soup. But we mustn't make it too salty — your mum doesn't like salty food.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Right. I'll keep the salt low. What about dessert?

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Let's bake an apple pie. Everyone loves your apple pie.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Then it's settled. I'd better write a shopping list before we forget anything.

exercises.translation_cn: Anna 周六请父母吃饭,商量做什么;爸爸爱吃烤牛肉,但妈妈说不该吃太多烤制食物;于是改做烤鸡配大量新鲜蔬菜;前菜做一道简单的汤,但不能太咸,因为妈妈不喜欢咸;甜点烤苹果派;最后 Anna 决定先列购物清单以免遗漏。

questions.stem: Why won't they cook a lot of roast food?
options: Nobody in the family likes roast food.
Anna's mother advises against eating too much of it.

exercises.title: U1 听力·独白 Don't Skip Breakfast
exercises.speaker: uk_male
exercises.transcript: Many students skip breakfast because they are in a hurry, but this is not a good habit. A good breakfast gives you energy and helps you stay awake in class. You needn't cook anything fancy. A bowl of yoghurt with fresh fruit, or some toast with honey, takes only a few minutes. Try to avoid sugary drinks in the morning, because too much sugar can make you feel tired later. Remember, what you eat at the start of the day really matters, so don't rush out with an empty stomach.
exercises.translation_cn: 许多学生因匆忙而不吃早餐,这是坏习惯。好的早餐能提供能量、帮助你上课保持清醒;不必做花哨的东西,一碗酸奶配新鲜水果、或几片抹蜂蜜的吐司只需几分钟;早上要少喝含糖饮料,糖太多会让你之后犯困;记住一天之初吃什么很重要,别空着肚子匆匆出门。
